quirks: OpenAI-compatible chat-completions API; required fields are model and messages.
messages is a standard JSON array of {role, content} objects (the schema mislabels it as type:object, but it is an array).
Response includes a separate reasoning_content (chain-of-thought) field alongside message.content; chain-of-thought is on by default for GLM-4.6.
max_tokens governs the reasoning+output budget; a small max_tokens (e.g. 16) yields finish_reason='length' and burns reasoning_tokens — set it generously (or omit) for complete answers.
Set stream:false (default) for a single synchronous JSON response.
usage.guide: POST a JSON body with model:"glm-4.6" and a messages array of {role,content} objects to the URL; payment is handled via x402 (~$0.01/call on Base). Read the assistant's answer from body.choices[0].message.content; the model's chain-of-thought is in body.choices[0].message.reasoning_content. Omit or set a generous max_tokens, since reasoning tokens count against it and a low limit truncates the reply (finish_reason='length'). Keep stream:false for a single synchronous response.
